lines.5: I didn't even want to remember it, but the situation was so similar that it dragged the memories out of me.
lines.6: 「President, please withdraw us from the gate cleaning after all. Even my elite father would say this is impossible.」
lines.7: 「I haven't defragmented recently, but my computer also concludes we should withdraw.」
lines.10: What would you do, Konoe? Dig in just like before?
lines.11: Then we'd only repeat the same thing.
lines.15: 「Then there'll be nobody to direct us, like.」
lines.16: 「We can't spare even one person from the decoration work either. My elite father would never make such a reckless decision--」
lines.18: 「I'll do all the same work as everyone else properly.」
lines.21: 「No. Once I've decided, I'll do it, senpai.」
lines.24: 「Even if we wanted to help, there isn't any time.」
lines.25: 「If taking the job guaranteed a budget increase, maybe. But we don't even know that, and doing this while we're already so busy... I still don't understand it.」
lines.26: 「That's not true. Even if the budget doesn't increase, hard work always gives something back. I'm doing this for the drama club's future!」
lines.29: 「Good. The problem is solved! We've spent enough time on this meeting, so let's start festival preparations right away!」
lines.30: 「I'll check the delivery arriving today. Everyone else, help decorate the field.」
lines.31: Everyone looked unsettled, but apparently there really was no time, because they immediately started moving.
lines.34: 「I'll explain the drama club's festival duties. If you're helping, I'm going to make you work hard.」
lines.37: This really was going to get busy.
lines.40: 「...Hmph. You were thinking this was just like the old days, weren't you?」
lines.43: 「It ended cleanly. I'll have to work harder, but I was the one who accepted the job, so that's only fair.」
lines.44: 「I won't make the same mistake twice.」
lines.47: 「You're the president, so I think they're just reluctantly following your orders.」
lines.48: 「Inside, I don't think they're satisfied at all with you doing everything alone.」
lines.49: 「Why!? I'm not ordering them to help by force. There's no problem!」
lines.50: 「I mean the underlying sense of solidarity.」
lines.52: 「Everyone joined because they love drama. What would you know, Tsushima!?」
lines.54: If we started arguing here, it really would be the same as before.
lines.55: If we were short on time, we needed to move our hands instead of our mouths.
lines.56: A delivery arrived from the contractor.
lines.58: 「Oh, these are lighter than I expected.」
lines.60: 「Don't trip because you're not looking ahead.」
lines.61: 「Leave it to me. Back to the club room, right?」
lines.62: 「Mm. While we walk, I'll explain the field decorations. Remember it the first time.」
lines.65: We reached the club room again.
lines.66: I set down the boxes I'd carried.
lines.73: 「What about handing pamphlets to visitors at the gate and guiding them on the day itself?」
lines.74: That was the only part she had not explained.
lines.75: 「That relates to what's in these boxes too... I'll explain tomorrow.」
lines.76: ...So I really did have to come in on the holiday tomorrow too.
lines.77: I had nothing else to do, so whatever.
lines.78: 「This room is pretty bare for a drama-club room.」
lines.79: 「Want to see the room next door? It's packed with props and set pieces.」
lines.81: 「We did make the prefectural tournament this spring.」
lines.83: 「...What a lukewarm reaction. Well, most people probably don't know.」
lines.84: I knew the number-one martial-arts club in Japan and the top scorer on national practice exams, so maybe my standards were getting distorted.
lines.85: My sense of scale had gone a little numb.
lines.86: 「The drama club's results have been improving nicely.」
lines.87: 「I've made practice tougher, but everyone loves theater, so they keep up.」
lines.88: 「The previous president asked me to look after the club, and I became president in my second year... I can't do this halfway.」
lines.89: 「Don't stay wound so tight all the time.」
lines.90: 「I don't need you worrying about me!」
lines.93: 「Right. We don't have time to stand here talking. We need to go.」
lines.100: In the end, we worked on the field until sunset.
